style: Wide cinematic landscape illustration, painterly semi-realistic, soft natural lighting, rich detail, calm uncluttered composition with a visually quiet center (suitable behind a login form), fixed tripod camera, 3:2 landscape. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no close-up people. The sun and the moon must NOT be visible anywhere in the sky (they are composited separately). Keep a generous area of open sky in the upper part of the frame.

times.day: clear bright daytime, soft white clouds, warm natural light
times.dawn: pre-sunrise dawn, the sun is still below the horizon, a peach and pink glow along the horizon on the LEFT (east) side fading to cool blue above, long soft shadows, a few lights still on
times.dusk: just after sunset, the sun is below the horizon, an orange and magenta afterglow along the horizon on the RIGHT (west) side fading to deep blue above, lights beginning to turn on
times.night: deep night with a clear starry sky and no moon, cool blue ambient light, artificial lights glowing warmly where appropriate

seasons.spring: spring: fresh light-green foliage, blossoms in bloom, soft hazy air
seasons.summer: summer: lush deep-green vegetation, strong clear light, vivid blue sky
seasons.autumn: autumn: red, orange and golden foliage, drier warmer light, fallen leaves
seasons.winter: winter: bare branches, crisp cold air, frost, and snow where the climate allows

mountain.name: 山
mountain.scene: A serene alpine valley seen from a lakeside meadow: a calm mirror-like lake in the foreground, pine forest on both sides, layered snow-capped mountain ranges rising in the distance, a small wooden cabin on the right shore.

seasonNotes.spring: meadow flowers, snowmelt, mountains still white on top
seasonNotes.summer: green meadow, snow only on the highest peaks
seasonNotes.autumn: larch and birch in gold and red
seasonNotes.winter: frozen lake, heavy snow on trees and cabin roof

mountain.nightNote: warm light in the cabin windows

city.name: 都会
city.scene: A generic modern big-city skyline from an elevated riverside viewpoint: dense mid-rise buildings and a cluster of ordinary glass office towers of varying heights in the distance, a wide river with one plain road bridge, tree-lined embankments in the foreground. An everyday metropolis that could be anywhere: NO famous landmarks, NO broadcast towers, NO distinctive or iconic buildings, NO trains, NO railway, NO text.

seasonNotes.spring: cherry blossom trees along the river
seasonNotes.summer: bright green street trees, strong light
seasonNotes.autumn: ginkgo trees turning yellow along the river
seasonNotes.winter: bare trees, crisp clear air, a light dusting of snow

city.nightNote: thousands of lit windows, glowing towers, light reflections on the river

harbor.name: 港町
harbor.scene: A generic harbor town seen from a hillside viewpoint: rows of ordinary low-rise houses and small apartment buildings climbing the hill in the foreground, a calm bay with a breakwater, container cranes and warehouses along the far shore, a few ferries and fishing boats on the water, low green hills in the distance. An ordinary everyday town that could be anywhere: NO famous landmarks, NO towers, NO distinctive or iconic bridges, NO distinctive buildings, NO text.

seasonNotes.spring: cherry blossom trees among the houses and fresh light-green hills
seasonNotes.summer: sparkling sea, deep green hills, strong clear light
seasonNotes.autumn: autumn color on the hills and garden trees
seasonNotes.winter: clear cold air, bare trees, a faint dusting of snow on the hilltops

harbor.nightNote: warm lit windows on the hillside, glittering harbor lights reflecting on the bay, lit cranes

cyber.name: サイバー
cyber.scene: A futuristic cyberpunk megacity seen from a rooftop terrace: towering skyscrapers with neon accents, abstract holographic signs (no readable text), elevated highways with light traffic, drones, layered fog between towers.

seasonNotes.spring: holographic cherry blossom petals drifting, pastel pink and cyan neon
seasonNotes.summer: hot hazy air, vivid magenta and teal neon, heat shimmer
seasonNotes.autumn: amber and orange neon tones, drifting digital leaves
seasonNotes.winter: icy blue and white neon, light snow in the neon glow

cyber.nightNote: dense bright neon, glowing reflections, strong volumetric light
cyber.water: any water or glossy wet street surface

beach.name: ビーチ
beach.scene: A tropical beach: palm trees on the left, white sand, turquoise shallow water, a distant island on the horizon, a wooden pier on the right, a couple of empty beach chairs and a parasol.

seasonNotes.spring: calm gentle sea, soft pastel light, a few flowers
seasonNotes.summer: intense turquoise water, bright white sand, high energy
seasonNotes.autumn: golden low light, calmer sea, fewer objects on the beach
seasonNotes.winter: cooler gray-blue sea, bigger waves, overcast softness, no snow

beach.nightNote: lanterns along the pier, gentle bioluminescent glow in the surf

home.name: 家
home.scene: The view seen through a large window from inside a house, looking out over a private garden with a low wooden fence, a few garden trees, neighboring tiled rooftops and gentle green hills in the distance under a wide sky. The camera is fixed. Show ONLY the outdoor scenery filling the entire frame: NO window frame, NO curtains, NO interior, NO glass reflections.

seasonNotes.spring: cherry and plum blossoms in the garden, fresh light-green leaves
seasonNotes.summer: lush green garden and hills, hydrangea, strong clear light
seasonNotes.autumn: maple and persimmon trees in red and orange, golden grass
seasonNotes.winter: bare trees, snow on the garden, rooftops and hills

home.nightNote: warm lit windows in the neighboring houses, a small garden lantern, distant town lights

inside.scene: A cozy Japanese-Scandinavian living room interior photographed straight on from the center of the room. A very large floor-to-ceiling window with thin frames fills the center and right of the frame, and the entire glass area is flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF. In the room: warm wooden floor, a sofa with cushions on the left, a leafy houseplant, a bookshelf, a low table with a cup, a soft rug.

props.summer: Add an electric standing fan on the floor near the window, a glass of iced tea on the table, and light linen cushions.
props.winter: Replace the low table with a kotatsu (a low table covered with a thick futon blanket, with a bowl of mikan oranges on top), put a knit blanket on the sofa, and add a soft warm glow of a small heater.

times.day: bright daylight from the window, lamps off
times.dawn: very early morning, dim cool blue ambient light, lamps off
times.dusk: dusk, warm lamps and ceiling light turned on, cozy
times.night: night, only warm lamps lit, cozy dim interior

office.name: オフィス
office.scene: The view seen through a floor-to-ceiling window from inside a high-rise office, looking out over a city skyline with a river, bridges, mid-rise and tall buildings and distant mountains under a wide sky. The camera is fixed and the horizon is in the middle of the frame. Show ONLY the outdoor scenery filling the entire frame: NO window frame, NO blinds, NO interior, NO glass reflections.

seasonNotes.spring: cherry blossom trees along the river, soft hazy light
seasonNotes.summer: strong clear light, lush green trees, vivid blue sky
seasonNotes.autumn: ginkgo and maple trees in yellow and red along the river, golden light
seasonNotes.winter: clear cold air, bare trees, a dusting of snow on distant mountains

office.nightNote: thousands of lit windows in the skyscrapers, glowing bridge lights reflected on the river

inside.scene: A modern open-plan office interior photographed straight on from the center of the room. A very large floor-to-ceiling window with thin frames fills the center and right of the frame, and the entire glass area is flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF. In the room: tidy white desks with dark monitors, ergonomic chairs, a long meeting table, potted plants, light wood flooring, ceiling lights.

props.summer: Add a small desktop fan on a desk, glasses of iced coffee on the meeting table, and leave the blinds fully open.
props.winter: Add a small decorated holiday tree in the corner, steaming mugs on the desks, and a coat rack with coats near the entrance.

times.day: bright daylight from the window, ceiling lights on softly
times.dawn: very early morning, dim cool blue ambient light, only a few lights on
times.dusk: dusk, warm ceiling lights and desk lamps turned on
times.night: night, office mostly dim with a few desk lamps lit, cool blue ambient light

earth.name: 地球
earth.scene: A view from high in the sky looking down toward the curved horizon of Earth: continents, ocean, swirling clouds, a thin glowing atmosphere line, deep space above with a few faint stars.

seasonNotes.summer: deep green land, small clouds, vivid blue ocean
seasonNotes.autumn: brown and golden land, increasing cloud swirls
seasonNotes.winter: extensive white snow cover on land, big storm systems

earth.nightNote: the visible side is in darkness with glowing golden city lights and a faint aurora near the poles

temple.name: 寺
temple.scene: A tranquil Japanese temple precinct: a red-lacquered five-story pagoda and a wooden main hall on stone-paved grounds, stone lanterns, a vermilion gate, old maple and cherry trees, forested mountains behind.

seasonNotes.spring: full cherry blossoms, petals on the stone path
seasonNotes.summer: deep green maples, cicada-season haze, strong dappled light
seasonNotes.winter: snow on roofs and stone lanterns, quiet white courtyard

temple.nightNote: glowing paper lanterns, lit pagoda, soft mist

fantasy.name: ファンタジー
fantasy.scene: A storybook fantasy forest: a colossal ancient tree with a glowing hollow and a treehouse village in its branches, a winding path leading to it with a tiny distant traveler carrying a lantern, mossy stones, old ruins, a small waterfall, tiny forest spirits.

seasonNotes.spring: luminous blossoms and fresh leaves on the giant tree, baby animals
seasonNotes.summer: dense emerald canopy, shafts of light, fireflies hinted in shadows
seasonNotes.autumn: the giant tree glowing red and gold, falling leaves, spirits gathering
seasonNotes.winter: snow-covered forest, frost-lit crystals on the tree, warm lights in the treehouses

fantasy.nightNote: glowing mushrooms, magical lights in the tree, floating particles of light
fantasy.water: the small pond and waterfall pool

kobe.name: 神戸
kobe.scene: The Kobe waterfront seen across the harbor from the Meriken Park pier: a calm bay in the foreground, the red lattice Kobe Port Tower, a tall hotel tower, the white sail-shaped museum roof, low waterfront buildings, and the Rokko mountain range rising behind the city.

seasonNotes.spring: fresh light-green Rokko hills, soft hazy air
seasonNotes.summer: deep green hills, sparkling water, strong clear light
seasonNotes.autumn: hills with red and golden color, dry warm light
seasonNotes.winter: clear cold air, a faint dusting of snow on the hill tops

kobe.nightNote: lit windows in the towers, the Port Tower softly lit, glittering harbor lights reflecting on the water
kobe.extraKeep: The tall hotel tower on the right of the Port Tower is a perfectly straight rectangular slab with vertical sides and a flat top; the red lattice Port Tower is a symmetric hyperboloid; the white museum roof and the arched bridge keep their exact shapes.

tokyo.name: 東京
tokyo.scene: A dense Tokyo cityscape seen from an elevated viewpoint: a sea of mid-rise buildings and glass towers, the red-and-white Tokyo Tower at left, trees of a park among the buildings, a distant Mount Fuji silhouette on the horizon.

seasonNotes.spring: cherry blossom trees in the park, soft hazy air
seasonNotes.summer: lush green park trees, strong clear light, vivid blue sky
seasonNotes.autumn: ginkgo and maple trees turning yellow and red, clear dry air
seasonNotes.winter: bare trees, crisp clear air, Mount Fuji with a snowy top

tokyo.nightNote: thousands of lit windows, the tower glowing orange, glowing office towers
